name: How much does door threshold removal and replacement cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does door threshold removal and replacement cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for door threshold removal and replacement in the Bay Area varies depending on the type of threshold, complexity of the installation, and whether new flooring or trim work is involved. Factors include the material of the new threshold (wood, metal, composite), the condition of the subfloor, and the labor required. For an accurate estimate, it's best to get a quote from a local contractor like City Dweller, LLC, who can assess the specific conditions of your doorway.
